comments.content: Placing a gas station on a roundabout is no less idiotic than putting a snowball stand on an overpass. This is a public safety issue for the department of transportation.

The logic of and justification for a boycott looks good to me. If there is no way that the city, county or ALDOT can prevent construction of a gas station, the citizens affected by it certainly have every right to vote against it by refusing to do business with the owner. Paul, if station comes to pass at that location please share the ownership information with us b

Are there no rules about what can be put within so many feet of a roundabout?  Seems placing businesses with their needed ingress and egress on a roundabout would completely counteract any safety and efficiency of roundabouts. Surely ALDOT has some rules on this 
It does point to the issue that Fairhope needs to bring its entire area into the City. This letting each property owner decide whether or not to be in the City or not, City taxpayer or not, subject to zoning or not, can only prevent Fairhope's comprehensive plan from working
You are right and  the matter is being looked into by the NEW administration
